title: FinCrime Policy Rule
description: A deterministic rule. No rule kind contains a free-text expression: if a constraint cannot be evaluated by code, it does not belong in the policy layer. See ADR-0003.

when.description: An artifact-level gate. The rule is evaluated only when the artifact satisfies it. This is how a rule reaches a property of the artifact header rather than of a claim.

jurisdictions.description: A rule with no jurisdiction applies structurally everywhere. A rule with a jurisdiction list is only evaluated for matching artifacts.

kind.description: The kind of a nested rule body. Only meaningful inside any_of, all, any and not; the top-level kind is the rule's own kind.

required.description: The field that must be present and truthy on every selected claim.

any_of.description: A per-claim disjunction: a claim satisfies the requirement when it satisfies any one of these bodies. Unlike composite.any, which aggregates across the whole selected set, any_of is decided claim by claim.

pattern.description: A regular expression. Under kind 'forbid', a claim statement that matches it is a violation. Matched case-insensitively.

negation_aware.description: Under kind 'forbid', evaluate the pattern per sentence and skip a sentence that carries a negation cue, so that 'not suspected of structuring' is not a violation. The same behaviour as the core's culpability lint.

field.description: A dotted path into the finding, for example artifact.completeness or provenance.knowledge_pack.stale.

contains.description: The field value contains this item. Applies to an array field or a string field.

matches.description: A regular expression matched against a string field, case-insensitively.
